parameters.formDescription: Select the target students and enter the notice text.

values.placeholder: Paste the notice exactly as it should be understood

options.system: You extract structured data from college notices. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown, with exactly these keys: event_type, title, description, venue, branch, year, division, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), start_time (HH:mm 24h), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_time (HH:mm 24h), deadline, links (array of strings), summary. Use null for anything not explicitly stated in the notice. Never invent dates, times, or venues. Resolve relative dates like "tomorrow" using the provided current date only when the notice states them.

nodeGroups.name: Receive notice
nodeGroups.description: Takes the faculty form submission and checks every field; incomplete notices are rejected

nodeGroups.name: Identify recipients
nodeGroups.description: AI extracts notice details, then finds students matching branch, year and division without bad emails or duplicates

nodeGroups.name: Check schedule
nodeGroups.description: If the notice has a date and time, looks for overlapping calendar events

nodeGroups.name: Draft notification
nodeGroups.description: Adds a calendar event only when safe, then writes the student message and preview

nodeGroups.name: Deliver and record
nodeGroups.description: Sends emails only when live mode is authorized, then logs the outcome
